details: The decimal point separates whole units on the left from fractional place values on the right.
Length: 1 cm = 10 mm => 1 mm = 0.1 cm (e.g., 3 mm = 0.3 cm); 1 m = 1000 mm => 1 mm = 0.001 m.
evidence_or_examples: Honeybee body length: Head 2.3 cm + Thorax 5.4 cm + Abdomen 7.5 cm = 15.2 cm total.

details: Appending trailing zeros to decimal places preserves value (0.2 = 0.20 = 0.200).
Adding and subtracting decimals requires vertical alignment of decimal points so matching place values are operated together.
evidence_or_examples: Comparing 0.2 and 0.09: 0.2 has 2 tenths while 0.09 has 0 tenths, so 0.2 > 0.09.
Fish length difference: Celestial Pearl Danio (2.4 cm) - Philippine Goby (0.9 cm) = 1.5 cm.
